page.notes: The first word is a fragment at the head of the page, so it is kept as a fragment (printed "stionem"). The small marks at the top left and in the body (e.g. beside "non", "criminis", "Ignatij") are ink specks or show-through, not printed text. "quo-" ends the page on a split word; "que" below the last line is the catchword.
